title: This-exact-date events drop the year column

history.detail:
PASS: PASS, gate 1, audit of a6eba5c, on branch devteam2/sprint-51 in Dev Team 2's worktree.

Sprint file: read fresh in the worktree. Against main, the only difference is the lifecycle-owned status line from the start. Its requirements are identical. Main's later sprint-52 amendments don't touch this sprint.

Handoff: read at the audited commit. It has a Round 1 section quoting VERIFY PASS (lint, typecheck, test, build) exit=0, with 601 tests.

Last commit: a6eba5c only reflows EventYear's doc comment, as stated (3 lines, comment-only). I audited the whole branch, 5a1df5b..a6eba5c.

My own check: npm run verify at a6eba5c in the worktree, on a clean tree. Result: verify=0, VERIFY PASS exit=0, 53 test files and 601 tests passed.

- R1 Met. ReadingView computes matched with hasMatchedEvents once. On a matched list each row gets eventRow plus eventRowSingle, and EventYear is not rendered at all (absent, not hidden). It is shared by both routes.
- R2 Met. Unmatched rows still render EventYear. accuracy-pages.test.ts (Sprint 39's year-link tests) is untouched on this branch and passes.
  Dev Team's question: removing EventYear's linked prop is fine, keep it. EventYear now renders only on unmatched lists, so the prop was always true, and behaviour is identical: a link when linkableEventDate gives a target, plain text otherwise.
- R3 Met. The CSS diff is one rule, .eventRow.eventRowSingle with grid-template-columns 1fr. Padding, divider, gap and text styles are untouched. The two-class selector, chosen so it also beats the later phone-breakpoint single-class .eventRow columns, is correct reasoning.
- R4 Met. The variant is chosen in ReadingView from hasMatchedEvents. No content-guessing selector is used. A test covers a string "true" matchedYear keeping the year column.
- R5 Met. event-rows-pages.test.ts covers matched and unmatched on both routes, through the real page components. It checks the description order, no year element, linked and plain years, and the source and (pictured) behaviour.
- R6 Met. I opened matched-1969-07-20-1280, matched-1969-07-20-390 and unmatched-1950-03-15-1280. The matched ones show a full-width description with no year; the unmatched one keeps the linked year column.

Independence: main has not touched ReadingView.tsx or reading.module.css since the branch base (git diff 5a1df5b main on both files is empty). So the files this sprint edits shouldn't conflict when it's merged, though sprint 50 may still touch them later.

No issues found. Still UNOWNED, with Master Controller: the 3 lint warnings in the sprint 45 and 46 probe scripts.
commit=b389c5c | ci=green: 1 CI run(s) for b389c5ccb5f8ea8d597a585e2667d25c258ae1f3 all completed successfully with real steps executed.

PASS: PASS (round 1). LiveQA steps 1 to 3 pass on production at 1280 and 390. No defects.

Tested 2026-11-25, about 16:31 to 16:35 UTC, against https://my-little-racoon.vercel.app.
Shipped commit b389c5c (the merge of devteam2/sprint-51). Production serves the pushed tip 6960485: /api/health/db reports status ok, connected true, commit 6960485, with migrationVersion unchanged at 20261122152710_navigation_exact_date_readings. git diff b389c5c origin/main touches no file under app/ or lib/; only Sprint 49's done-rename, registry.json, and the state files for Sprints 49, 50 and 51.
Tools: headless Chromium (Playwright 1.57) at 1280x900, and 390x900 (isMobile, hasTouch). Element screenshots of each "What happened" section: s51-<width>_<page>.png.

STEP 1, matched /date/1969-07-20: PASS at both widths. Status "this exact date", 1 row with classes "eventRow eventRowSingle".
- grid-template-columns: 494px at 1280, 326px at 390.
- The row has 1 child and no year element in the DOM.
- The description is full row width (494 of 494, and 326 of 326), starting at offset 0. The text starts "The Apollo 11 Lunar Module Eagle landed on the Sea...".
- The source link is https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apollo_11, and fetching it gave HTTP 200.
- Row style is unchanged: padding 13px/13px and font 17.5px Cormorant Garamond (1280); 11px/11px and 16.5px (390). Bottom border 1px solid. No "pictured" text.
- Also matched: /date/1912-04-15 (1 row) and /date/2020-03-11 (2 rows, both single-column, no year, full width, each with a source link). Screenshots: s51-1280_date_2020_03_11.png and s51-390_date_1969_07_20.png.

STEP 2, unmatched /date/2026-11-25 (today; the feed has no 2026 match): PASS at both widths. Status "on this day, other years", 5 rows with class "eventRow" only.
- grid-template-columns: 62px 416px at 1280, 52px 262px at 390. Each row has 2 children.
- Years: 2013, 1984, 1981, 1975, 1970. Each is a link to /date/<year>-11-25.
- Same padding, border and font as the matched rows.
- Clicking 2013 lands on /date/2013-11-25 ("Retroactive Horoscope 2013-11-25", status "this exact date"), at both widths.
- No unlinkable year appeared in this list, so the plain-text-year case wasn't observed live; Sprint 39's tests cover it, and QA1 confirmed they're unchanged.

STEP 3, /reading/<id>: PASS.
- Matched /reading/0b01c79f-73d5-4fbc-afeb-d65da32ae38d (1969-07-20): single-column at both widths (494px and 326px), no year element, source link present.
- For comparison, unmatched /reading/9bd536d1-243f-49e7-8c59-af75b6d76067 keeps the two columns. Years 2019, 2013, 2007, 1990 and 1977 link to /date/<year>-07-21.

Note: 2020-03-11's first event reads "officialy" (sic). That spelling is in the Wikipedia feed text itself; the app didn't add it.
